canon.note: AGENTS.md kit note aventurine_waveflair: Skill 151302 'Kill Shot, the Sands Boil' AoE Quantum + Punchline #2 + Fervor #3, Ult 151303 'Grand Slam, Crest That High Tide' + Punchline/Fervor/SPD, Talent 'Ante Up, the Abyss Answers' checkpoint at 10 Fervor fires Cheers! and arms All In!, Aha Instant grants Certified Banger, energyMax 130

fixtures.env: Duo E0 Aventurine • Waveflair + E0 March 7th • The Hunt (teammate: each of her attacks grants Aventurine +1 Fervor +1 Punchline via Talent), Aventurine stats atk 3000/spd 160 (traces on: SPD+9 -> eff 169, crit +18.7%, elation +10%), skillPriority 2, energyStartFrac 0.5 (65/130 EN), March stats atk 3000/spd 140 skillPriority 0 (designates Aventurine as Shifu once, then Basics to feed Fervor and SP), vs a dummy Elite (atk 0, Quantum+Imaginary weakness, 600 Toughness), 3 cycles. Rotation: Skill 'Kill Shot, the Sands Boil' (+4 Punchline, +4 Fervor) -> teammate attacks push Fervor to 10 -> Talent checkpoint uses 'Cheers! To Summer's Blaze' and arms All In! -> Aha Instant consumes the armed state with 'All In!' and grants Certified Banger -> Skill/Ult CB-gated Elation hits; auto-Ult 'Grand Slam, Crest That High Tide'

requirements.claim: Skill 151302 'Kill Shot, the Sands Boil' is the AoE Quantum skill hit (dataset 151302 type BPSkill, tag AoEAttack).
Basic 'Dead Center, the Torrent Hits' fires when SP is dry (kit decide: SP >= 1 -> skill, else basic).
Ultimate 'Grand Slam, Crest That High Tide' is cast from an auto-ult turn (charTurn full-energy rule: 130/130 EN).
Talent 'Ante Up, the Abyss Answers' fires 'Cheers! To Summer's Blaze' when a Fervor checkpoint is crossed (kit checkFervor).

of.log: Elation Skill: Cheers! To Summer's Blaze

requirements.claim: The checkpoint arms the next Aha Instant, which uses the enhanced 'All In! To Summer's Blaze' (kit elSkill allIn branch).

of.log: Elation Skill: All In! To Summer's Blaze

requirements.claim: The Aha Instant grants Aventurine Certified Banger equal to the Punchline taken into the instant (TurnManager ahaTurn -> addCb).
'Cheers!' deals the fixed instance count el_skill2_a2 = 10 at L10 (kit log 'Cheers! ... (10 instances)').

of.log: Elation Skill: Cheers! To Summer's Blaze \(10 instances\)

requirements.claim: The E0 Fervor checkpoint is talent L10 = 10 points (PROG talent ladder Array(15).fill(10), fervorSteps).
Casting the auto-ult consumes the full 130 Energy pool (Energy.md canon: castUlt ENERGY_LOSS reason ult_cost, amount 130) and energy never exceeds the 130 cap afterwards.
Ultimate grants SPD +30% for 4 turns (PROG ult_a4 L10 = 0.3, ult_a5 = 4, buff aw_ult_spd).
'All In!' can only fire after the Fervor checkpoint armed awAllInNext (kit checkFervor -> elSkill allIn).

after.log: Elation Skill: All In! To Summer's Blaze

requirements.claim: The CB-gated Skill Elation hit 'Kill Shot, the Sands Boil (CB)' only fires while holding Certified Banger, so the Aha CB gain precedes it (kit: sim.cbOf gate).
The CB-gated Ult Elation hit 'Grand Slam, Crest That High Tide (CB)' fires only after Certified Banger was granted (kit ult: sim.cbOf(u) > 0 gate).

after.label: Grand Slam, Crest That High Tide (CB)

requirements.claim: E0 checkpoint list is a single step (fervorSteps: [10]), and each crossing fires exactly once per checkpoint pass: first crossing at Fervor 15 arms All In, All In resets awThresh/awFervor to 0 (kit allIn branch), second crossing at Fervor 10 re-arms it. Total 'reaches N Fervor' notes in this battle = 2.
The Ult SPD buff (aw_ult_spd) lands on Aventurine himself (kit perform ult self addBuff), not on the teammate.
E1 'A Holiday on the Line' All-Type RES PEN +24% must never appear at E0 (kit onStart eidolon guard).
